tickets.name: [Home Page] [Global Runtime Section] Uncaught JS Error: Identifier 'section' has already been declared
tickets.description:
### Summary
Uncaught JavaScript runtime exception detected on the live preview page.

### Impact
This uncaught syntax error stops subsequent script execution, breaking interactive components such as cart drawers, sliders, and variant selectors.

### Actual Behavior
`Identifier 'section' has already been declared`

### Environment
- **Project**: `Irreverent`
- **Page**: `Home`
- **URL**: `https://www.irreverentink.com/?preview_theme_id=181104476407`
